exposure: dedicated team for external cephalic version
Dedicated team for external cephalic version
outcome: success rate of external cephalic version
cohort: 673 women with a singleton fetus in breech presentation
finding: Introducing a dedicated team significantly increased the success rate of external cephalic version and decreased the cesarean section rate for breech presentation.
mod_finding: Following the introduction of a dedicated team, the rate of vaginal delivery after external cephalic version increased, while the rate of cesarean section decreased.
